build.//: Build the consolidated MagicAST test harness (NUnit tests + Flowthru triage flow).

test.//: Run the MagicAST NUnit suite. Every test must pass green; no ratchet tolerance.

run.//: Run the MagicAstTriage Flowthru flow over the corpus and emit Data/_08_Reporting/triage-report.json.

span-witness.//: The span-witness error-check (mast-loop Error-check track entry): flags parsed ports whose SourceSpan text lacks the anchor their label asserts (a false-positive port or a span mis-attribution) and routes each suspect to the golds that witness its ADR-3 stem via the cited topology — emits span-witness-report.json (gitignored). Run after 'run'/CardAtlas has refreshed card-ports.json so the ports checked are current. Never a gate; the NUnit span-provenance invariants are the gate.

artifact-census.//: ADR-0004 §1 artifact census: enumerates every artifact under tests/**/Fixtures, **/Data/_08_Reporting, dumps/, libs/**/*.json (plus the committed snapshot families) and classifies each Evidence / Derived / architectural-decision, flagging the genuinely ambiguous residue for human classification — emits Data/_08_Reporting/artifact-census.json (gitignored). Hermetic: working tree only, no corpus, no network. Never a gate; the NUnit ArtifactClassificationGateTests is the gate ('an unclassified artifact fails the build').

interaction-triage.//: Fast data-triage: the InteractionTriage flow sliced (Flowthru --only auto-includes upstream) to ClassifyCombos + MaterializeCardEdges — emits interaction-triage-report.json (worklist) + card-edges.json + port-graph-metrics.json, EXCLUDING the intractable MaterializeCycles/PortNodes/PlotInteractionGraph viz tail (union cycle enumeration over a ~1.1M-edge graph). The canonical re-triage for the loop + the input to the corpus-edge-diff gate. Use 'interaction-graph' (full flow) only when the viz HTML is wanted.

combo-anchors.//: Combo-ANCHORED pick surface: the InteractionTriage flow sliced to RankComboAnchors (Flowthru --only auto-includes upstream FetchCombos; reads the existing parse-records.json + card-inputs.json) — emits combo-anchor-report.json. Ranks unparsed hub cards by the combo-popularity value each gates (sole-blocker counts, co-star neighborhood, parser-family vs empty-oracle-text DATA-gap split): the demand-side pick surface for the mast-tdd-loop, complementing triage-report.json's supply-side yield clusters. Never a gate. Run after 'run' has refreshed parse-records.json.

recall-report.//: Regenerate the wide reconstruction-recall measurement: the CardAtlas flow (D1-D4 over the parse-ready CSB combo-card union) emits Data/_08_Reporting/extended-recall-report.json — reconstruction recall over EVERY projection-ready combo (green/amber/missed + recallAtGreen + popularity-weighted recall), the number that actually moves per batch (the gold-33 bench is the regression GATE; this is the product SCOREBOARD). Feed it to 'tools/recall-log.sh <label>' to append the per-batch snapshot + delta to the tracked docs/judgments/recall-log.jsonl. Needs the live corpus (main-only); measurement, never a gate.

seed-ontology.//: Regenerate the MTG type ontology from the upstream mtg-rules project and copy it into this project's Curated input layer. Preserves the explicit 'copied from mtg-rules' provenance; the raw CR text stays in mtg-rules (gitignored). Run after mtg-rules' ontology rules change.

gate-test.//: Hermetic self-tests for the MAST loop meta tier (tools/test/*/run.sh): deterministic gates (initiative 01) + discriminator lint (initiative 02). CI-safe — builds throwaway git repos / synthetic source in a temp dir; no network, no dependency on the live corpus. Runs alongside the core NUnit suite.

worktree-clean.//: Reap MAST TDD-loop agent worktrees + merged agent branches (run after every batch). Default deletes only MERGED mast-tdd/* and worktree-agent-* branches; for a DISCARDED batch run `bash tools/clean-worktrees.sh --force` to also drop unmerged ones.
